#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Resolve the directory containing this script so it can be run from anywhere
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PYTHON_CMD="${PYTHON:-python3}"

if [ ! -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/security_patch.py" ]; then
  echo "[ERROR] security_patch.py not found in $SCRIPT_DIR" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "[INFO] Launching security_patch.py from $SCRIPT_DIR using $PYTHON_CMD"
exec "$PYTHON_CMD" "$SCRIPT_DIR/security_patch.py"
